purpose: Machine-readable routing contract for docs/GENRE_ROUTING_MATRIX.md and Command Center genre evaluation.

profiles.intent: Evidence-led factual storytelling using real source material and traceable claims.
requiredEvidence: Claim-source ledger with source URLs and timecodes
Asset provenance, rights, releases and attribution
Factual review of every material claim
Full audiovisual review and continuity check
criticalGuardrails: Never invent archive footage, interview quotes, source timestamps or factual claims.
Distinguish verified fact, inference, reconstruction and opinion on screen or in narration.
Preserve original source files and document every crop, edit or synthetic reconstruction.

profiles.intent: Teach a concept accurately through equations, data, diagrams, experiments and narration.
requiredEvidence: Verified equations, assumptions, units and source data
Reproducible chart inputs and calculation checks
Narration-to-equation/diagram synchronization review
Full audiovisual review for reading time and comprehension
criticalGuardrails: Do not animate an equation or numerical claim before validating it independently.
Label units, axes, scale, uncertainty and simplifications where relevant.
Use 3D only when spatial reasoning benefits; do not add complexity for decoration.

profiles.intent: Deliver a coherent fictional story with consistent characters, locations, actions and emotional beats.
requiredEvidence: Approved script-to-shot coverage and visual bible
Character, prop and environment continuity references
Action/contact/follow-through motion proofs for complex shots
Rights, captions, sound sync and full audiovisual review
criticalGuardrails: Do not impose the existing stick-figure/H2 look on unrelated stories or genres.
Keep character identity, props, screen direction and location landmarks consistent.
Treat still frames as staging evidence only; review moving action and transitions.

profiles.intent: Show truthful, reproducible product behavior with readable UI and clear user outcomes.
requiredEvidence: Product build/version and reproducible click-path record
Actual UI capture or a disclosed, source-validated synthetic reconstruction
Privacy/secrets redaction audit
UI text, captions and behavior verified against the real product
criticalGuardrails: Never depict an unimplemented feature or mock state as real product behavior.
Keep evidence captures distinct from designed overlays and disclose synthetic UI where necessary.
Redact credentials, customer records and other private information before capture.

profiles.intent: Enable viewers to perform a task correctly and independently.
requiredEvidence: Observable learning objective and step-to-objective coverage
Version-specific commands and steps executed successfully
Cursor, zoom, labels and screen text readable at target size
Complete captions/transcript and full audiovisual review
criticalGuardrails: Do not present an untested command or workflow as verified.
Show prerequisites, expected result and recovery path for failure-prone steps.
Prefer one action per visual beat; do not hide important UI state behind decorative overlays.

profiles.intent: Preserve the meaning and intelligibility of recorded speech while shaping a deliberate viewing experience.
requiredEvidence: Recording consent and source-media rights
Transcript decisions and speaker labels reviewed against source audio
Caption timing/alignment and sync evidence
Measured loudness, true peak, channel balance and full audiovisual review
criticalGuardrails: Never infer a speaker's identity or attribute a quote without evidence.
Treat ASR as a draft; review dropped words, overlaps, names, numbers and multilingual speech.
Preserve source audio and document edits that change meaning or context.

profiles.intent: Create a visual progression that responds intentionally to music, performance and rhythm.
requiredEvidence: Music, recording, footage and performer rights
Track analysis and beat/phrase map tied to source time
Cut and motion sync review against the actual audio
Full audiovisual review and final master measurements
criticalGuardrails: Never assume automatic beat detection is editorially correct.
Do not use copyrighted music or footage without the required rights.
Avoid visual cuts that follow every beat mechanically when the music or story calls for contrast.

profiles.intent: Communicate one clear idea quickly in a phone-first viewing context.
requiredEvidence: Hook and message payoff coverage
9:16 safe-area and mobile-size text/caption review
Platform-specific duration, codec and audio checks
CTA, caption coverage and full mobile-size playback review
criticalGuardrails: Do not shrink essential text to fit; rewrite or recompose it for mobile.
Keep faces, UI controls and captions clear of platform overlays and device safe areas.
Do not use a generic hook/template when it misrepresents the content.

profiles.intent: Present a persuasive creative idea without making unapproved product, price, performance or endorsement claims.
requiredEvidence: Approved claims, prices, offer terms and required disclosures
Brand, trademark, likeness, voice, music and media permissions
Product truth and visual brand consistency review
Final legal/brand approval and full audiovisual review
criticalGuardrails: Never invent a testimonial, endorsement, certification, price, result or product capability.
Do not imitate a real person's voice or likeness without documented permission.
Do not publish a campaign until required claim and rights approvals are recorded.

profiles.intent: Combine generated media with deterministic composition while preserving provenance, truth and editability.
requiredEvidence: Provider, model/version, prompt, seed and generation-date provenance where available
Input/output rights, likeness/privacy and disclosure assessment
Factual/visual artifact inspection and editable exact text/data
Generation cost record and full composited audiovisual review
criticalGuardrails: Keep exact typography, product UI, equations and legal copy outside generative video frames.
Do not download model weights or call paid providers without an explicit resource and cost review.
Inspect generated media for hallucinations, identity drift, temporal defects and rights restrictions.
